title: CLARITY Act expected to miss its window before Congress' summer break, leadership says
summary: Majority Leader Thune says the merged 616-page market-structure draft lacks the votes to pass before the August recess, reversing his July 14 commitment to a pre-recess vote.

title: Thune: CLARITY Act lacks votes before August recess
summary: The revised Senate substitute failed to bring aboard the seven negotiating Democrats (Warner, Alsobrooks, Gallego, et al.); floor process may still start before the break.

title: Galaxy Digital cuts 2026 CLARITY passage odds from 50% to 30%
summary: Four working days remain before recess; the vehicle stays H.R. 3633 with a full strike-and-replace substitute.

title: Sen. McCormick's Bitwise stake and BITB purchases draw scrutiny ahead of market-structure vote
summary: Reporting hit McCormick's Bitwise equity stake plus ~$1.6M of 2025 BITB buys while Senate Banking writes crypto law.
